name: pdfInfo
description: Returns metadata about a PDF document as a struct: { pages, source, pagesizes }. pages is the page count, source is the file path (empty when the document was read from a Binary), and pagesizes is an array of { width, height } structs in PostScript points (1/72 inch).

params.name: pdfObj
params.description: A PDF object from pdfRead() or pdf().

examples.title: Get PDF metadata
examples.description: Read a PDF and dump its info struct.
